decision_record.calculation: Filter fixture: newest bar 2026-10-01 judged 2026-10-23 (22 days) -> refused; newest bar 2026-10-22 -> passes.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: spot = last daily close, however old; the sleeve gates the SCAN's age (8 days, fail-closed) but never the bar's. ENH1 fixed which expiry qualifies (>= earnings+26d); the price basis went unaged.
decision_record.experiment: Filter-level A/B (gate is the unit; structure selection oracle-covered): stale/fresh cases above.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution freshness: refuse entries when the symbol's newest served 1Day bar is more than 7 days old at decision time (the batch-18 stale-bar bound; longest legitimate gap ~4.4 days). Exits never gated.
decision_record.transfer: The defined-risk structure is selected and sized off spot: the spread's strikes bracket the CURRENT price and the debit band is judged against it. A spot read off a weeks-old daily bar builds the structure around a price the stock no longer trades at.

switch: extra.earnings_buyback_enh2.stale_bar_gate default ON; OFF restores the pre-change rule exactly
